conbody.p: The "Darwin" in Darwin Information Typing Architecture refers to the principle of specialization—the ability to evolve and adapt content structures to meet specific domain needs while maintaining compatibility with the broader DITA framework. Just as biological species evolve through specialization, DITA allows organizations to extend standard elements to create domain-specific content models.
